title: Aadhaar Paperless Offline e-KYC
section: then get Certificate from [here](https://backend.uidai.gov.in/get/files/media/document/2026-05/okyc-publickey.cer)   5. If you have downloaded Offline XML before 18 Jun 2019. then get Certificate from [here](https://backend.uidai.gov.in/get/files/media/document/2026-05/okyc-publickey.cer)   6. If you have downloaded the client before 28 March, then get Certificate from [here](https://backend.uidai.gov.in/get/files/media/document/2026-05/okyc-publickey.cer).  7. Convert certificate to base64 string.  8. Sample code snippets provided [here](https://backend.uidai.gov.in/get/files/media/document/2026-05/okyc-publickey.cer). XML Validation steps  1. Aadhaar Paperless Offline e-KYC XML is zipped and protected with the “Share Phrase”. It can be unzipped using any standard unzipping utility (like WinZip, WinRaR, 7Zip etc.). While unzipping, a prompt will show for password where “Share Phrase” should be entered. 2. Parse the XML and use the logic mentioned earlier to validate the digital signature. 3. Optionally do OTP validation against the mobile number (Aadhaar number holder needs to provide mobile number which can be hashed and verified against the KYC data) and/or do face validation by capturing face and matching against the photo within the e-KYC XML.  Content Information Published on: 30 Apr 2026 Last Updated: 03 Jul 2026 Owner: A & V
